name: Cosmo First Limited
summary: Cosmo First Limited mainly makes and sells biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) films for packaging, lamination, labeling and industrial uses in India and abroad. It also supplies specialty chemicals and runs a pet care platform covering food, supplements, hygiene products, accessories, toys and services such as veterinary care and grooming. Established in 1976, it was formerly Cosmo Films Limited.
